workload: transaction rollback exception with independent acceptance checks and regression tests
method: One cold request per method, then two repetitions x eight queries per method, interleaved order, separate identical banks, equality outside timers. Wall time surrounds the actual service.select including qualification/Git/SQLite/application and diagnostics. Task creation and panel serialization are excluded. Nearest-rank percentiles.
limitations: One local run over 1/10 synthetic text variants of one independently verified repair; not production traffic or an independent strategy corpus.
Original and reuse arms keep live evidence/scope/feedback checks; full-chain improvements may be negligible or negative.
Legacy build work is included in query time; prepared index construction is separate. Cache only retains an unchanged eligible bank.
No model, provider delivery, downstream task acceptance, token cost or financial benefit was evaluated.
Sixteen warm observations per method/size are descriptive, not a robust tail-latency estimate.
